name: Darnassus Marzipan
summary: Darnassus Marzipan is a festive confectionery crafted in the night elven capital for the autumn celebration of Hallow's End. Innkeepers in Darnassus hand it out to trick-or-treaters willing to dance for their sweet reward.

sections.title: A Taste of the World Tree
sections.body: During Hallow's End, the capital cities of the Alliance take part in lighthearted trick-or-treat traditions. While the dwarves offer sharp mints and Stormwind crafts chewy nougat, the innkeepers of Darnassus prepare delicate marzipan for visitors. Obtaining a piece requires visitors to showcase a bit of festive spirit—specifically, dancing on command for the innkeeper. The confection is one of four regional treats sought by young Jesper, a sick orphan in Stormwind's Cathedral Square who cannot go out to collect sweets himself.

faq.q: What is Darnassus Marzipan used for?
aliases: what do i do with marzipan
faq.answer: Darnassus Marzipan is one of four distinct sweets needed by Jesper, a sick orphan at the orphanage in Stormwind's Cathedral Square during Hallow's End. Delivering it alongside candies from Ironforge, Gnomeregan, and Stormwind earns a bundle of festive pumpkin treats in exchange.

faq.q: How do you obtain Darnassus Marzipan?
faq.answer: It is granted by the innkeepers of Darnassus during Hallow's End. An innkeeper will ask you to perform a quick dance before parting with the sweet confection.

faq.q: Why can't Jesper get the marzipan himself?
faq.answer: Jesper is sick and cannot go out trick-or-treating. He is at the Stormwind orphanage in Cathedral Square, and relies on adventurers to collect the distant treats for him.

angles.text: Even the solemn kaldorei embrace the lighter customs of autumn, offering sugary marzipan to travelers who honor their hospitality with a lively dance.
Collecting treats from Darnassus, Ironforge, and Stormwind unites the far-flung peoples of the Alliance through shared Hallow's End festivities.
